create_docker_jobspec: create a docker jobspec for running a distribution test shell command inside a container
create_jobspec: create a jobspec for running a distribution test command with optional workspace isolation
build_CSharpDistribTest: build a CSharpDistribTest instance for a given platform and arch then call build_jobspec
build_PythonDistribTest: build a PythonDistribTest instance for a given platform and arch then call build_jobspec
targets: get the full list of supported distribution test targets across all languages and platforms
